purpose: Resolve native range field units/endpoint and absolute sample origin without conflating reader-relative cursors or padded callback span.
required_same_execution_fields: native range start/end field names and units
reader absolute sample/file offset before and after each read
direct actual read-count vector per channel
pre-read zero-fill extent and tail read extent
downstream descriptor frame span and generation owner
do_not_infer: end inclusive/exclusive from numeric value alone
source sample count from padded callback span
cross-run identity from equal input/output hashes
